_comment: Copy to local.settings.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Uses your `az login` identity, so grant YOURSELF the same data roles as the Functions managed identity (Service Bus Data Receiver, Event Hubs Data Receiver, Storage Blob Data Contributor, Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor). Durable Functions keeps the saga's state in AzureWebJobsStorage: run Azurite for UseDevelopmentStorage=true.

Values._phase16: Leave empty to run payments and shipping in-process. Point at local runs of the two APIs, or at Azure (then add the scopes).
